method: Public pages only. Not a ranking. Not a scrape of reviews. Gaps are hypotheses to verify, not verdicts.

subject.name: Ecowoods Hardwood Flooring Inc.
observed_strengths: Published CAD and USD price bands
Dated HomeStars and Google counts instead of a homemade aggregate
llms.txt, ai.txt, Markdown twins, knowledge API
Explicit 'dust-free is not zero dust' definition
observed_weaknesses: Google review count far below HomeStars count
Credential names competitors use (Bona, NWFA, ASTM F2170) are not in the llms identity block — either absent or unpublished

competitors.name: Green Hardwood
observed: Positions floor + stair + rail as one shop and says most GTA firms subcontract the stair
Publishes refinishing about $4.50–$8.50 / sq ft and install about $11–$22
States dust-free is not 100 percent and names Bona-class systems
competitors.where_they_can_beat_ecowoods: Queries that bind stairs and railings as a single system, if Ecowoods pages do not answer the rail as clearly as the floor.

competitors.name: Toronto Quality Wood Flooring
observed: Names Bona Certified since 2005 and NWFA-trained crew
Names ASTM F2170 on concrete slabs
States a 36-to-120 grit sequence and a 99.8 percent dust-capture figure
competitors.where_they_can_beat_ecowoods: Any query that rewards a named certification or a named ASTM method. Specificity beats a careful paragraph when the question is 'who is certified'.

competitors.name: GTA Flooring Experts / Toronto Flooring Contractors
observed: Markets 99 percent dust-free and HEPA vacuums
Broad 'top-tier' copy, thinner technical specification on the fetched page
competitors.where_they_can_beat_ecowoods: Generic 'near me' pages if Ecowoods loses on Maps pack rather than on documents. Documents will not win the map pack.

competitors.name: Roundup pages (example)
observed: A '10 best' list fetched 2026-10-29 showed other firms (including HBueno Flooring and Heritage Hardwood Flooring) in the visible portion. Ecowoods was not in that visible portion. This is not proof of absence.
competitors.where_they_can_beat_ecowoods: Models quote listicles. One accurate citation of the Framework on a page Ecowoods does not own is worth more than another essay on ecowoods.ca.
